title: Rough log-normal stochastic volatility with quadratic drift: second-moment stability and the martingale property under positive correlation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We extend the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation. The volatility has a unique global non-negative solution with finite moments on every finite horizon. With linear drift we derive the conditional first and second moments, expected integrated variance and conditional squared VIX. We give the exact threshold for a uniformly bounded second moment and the exponential growth rate above it. With positive quadratic damping the second moment is uniformly bounded for every admissible Hurst exponent and volatility of volatility. A separate bound on long-run expected integrated variance per unit time depends only on the drift parameters. Under the share measure the volatility beta offsets the quadratic damping. translated_title: 具有二次漂移的粗糙对数正态随机波动率：二阶矩稳定性与正相关下的鞅性质
translated_abstract: 我们将带二次漂移的对数正态随机波动率模型扩展为分数Volterra方程。波动率存在唯一的整体非负解，且在每个有限时间范围内具有有限矩。在线性漂移下，我们推导了条件一阶矩与二阶矩、期望积分方差以及条件平方VIX。我们给出了二阶矩一致有界的精确阈值，以及超过该阈值时的指数增长率。在正二次阻尼下，对于每个可容许的Hurst指数和波动率的波动率，二阶矩均一致有界。关于单位时间长期期望积分方差的另一个界仅取决于漂移参数。在份额测度下，波动率beta会抵消二次阻尼。当阻尼足以覆盖beta时，价格是真正的鞅。对于正的有限指数混合，该条件也是必要的。关于奇异分数核的逆命题（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将带二次漂移的对数正态随机波动率模型推广至分数Volterra方程，证明了正二次阻尼可确保二阶矩一致有界，并给出价格成为真正鞅的精确条件——即二次阻尼足以覆盖波动率beta。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the log-normal stochastic volatility model with quadratic drift to a fractional Volterra equation, proves uniform boundedness of the second moment under positive quadratic damping, and establishes the exact condition for the price to be a true martingale—namely, that the damping covers the volatility beta.
